text:
Maya: PSA — whoever keeps microwaving fish in the kitchen, we can smell it from the dev desks :nauseated_face:
Aj: guilty? maybe once? :eyes:
Maya: Aj. we have officially dubbed it 'The Fish Fog'. Please cease at once.
Keelin: kitchen rules refresher: 1) label food, 2) use the labeled shelf, 3) ventilate and lid before heating. Simple.
Isla: we should elect a Microwave Marquis to patrol for culinary crimes :crown: (court of cuisine?)
Sam: I second the Microwave Marquis. Aj's day-1 tuna incident qualifies him as a suspect, if not a titleholder. :popcorn:
Aj: I'll accept the title on one condition: the crown is aluminum foil. Fair? :sweat_smile:
OpsBot: Note: office microwave is shared resource. Please wipe spills and avoid strong-odour items. Incident logged: MW-2025-23.
Maya: proposal: tiny jar of "fish soap" by the sink (obviously a gag). :soap:
Keelin: poll: 5-min 'Microwave Etiquette Training' at next all-hands? React :thumbsup: for yes, :thumbsdown: for no, :laughing: for duel.
Isla: placing a 'NO FISH' sticker on the microwave tonight. Who's in?
Sam: I'll mock up a sticker — tiny fish on a lifeboat with 'Not Today' text.
Aj: ok ok, I'll stop nuking tuna at 3pm. But only if desperate times don't require it.
Maya: huge thanks to Keelin for being our unofficial kitchen ambassador :heart:
Keelin: I'll accept the badge if it's laminated and has adhesive backing. Priorities.
Isla: new lore entry: "The Microwave Marquis" established. Eng-rituals committee, please archive. :scroll:
Sam: can we get a tiny ceremonial crown for the microwave? low-cost, highly performative.
Aj: will model crown in next all-hands photo. Someone ensure OpsBot doesn't file a dignity complaint. :robot_face:
Maya: note for future historians: there was once a Great Microwave Conspiracy. We survived. :sparkles:
Keelin: reminder — if you smell something, say something. Also, if you use the microwave, just clean it. It takes 10 seconds.
OpsBot: reminder scheduled: "Microwave Etiquette" poster to be printed in lounge. ETA: tomorrow.
Sam: sticker concept uploaded to #design in 10.
Aj: I'll bring foil. For crown-making only, I promise.
Isla: vote tally so far: :thumbsup: 4, :laughing: 1. Training scheduled? Maybe just a quick demo at lunch.
Maya: agreement: quick lunch demo + sticker + ceremonial crown. Case closed. :white_check_mark:
